verdict.rationale: Evidence documents llama.cpp running standard LLMs (Qwen) and multimodal/vision models (Gemma-3, VLM via llama-mtmd-cli) both via first-party CLI examples and hands-on community reports, supporting the 'hundreds of architectures' and 'multi-modal' parts of the story. However, there is no explicit evidence for MoE model support or embedding-model support in this pack, and one community comment notes vision support was previously removed and later restored, showing some historical fragility in multi-modal coverage. missing for 10: MoE architecture examples, embedding-model support evidence, broader architecture-count documentation
